supplier_statement_rule.formal_manufacturer_declaration_rule: A formal declaration is evaluated as an artifact only when it identifies issuer, product or material scope, date, claim scope, and accountable source.

consistency_relation_rule: No live relation is created in Stage 3. CONTRADICTS requires sufficiently comparable product family, configuration, batch, factory, method, conditions, date, and source; otherwise NOT_COMPARABLE may apply.
disclosure_event_rule: No live disclosure event is created in Stage 3. Event language records material information without inferring intent.

claim_evidence_requirements.claim_text: Provider evidence supports that the referenced hose or product family uses a platinum-cured silicone system.
claim_evidence_requirements.claim_scope: Referenced hose or product family and the documented formulation or manufacturing scope only.
claim_evidence_requirements.notes: Do not infer reinforcement, pressure, temperature, or food-contact compliance from this claim alone.

claim_evidence_requirements.claim_text: Provider evidence supports reinforced construction for the referenced silicone hose or product family.
claim_evidence_requirements.claim_scope: Referenced construction or product family and documented reinforcement type only.
claim_evidence_requirements.notes: Do not infer reinforcement material, braid count, pressure rating, or performance of another series.

claim_evidence_requirements.claim_text: Provider evidence supports a maximum working pressure of at least 9 bar for the referenced hose configuration under documented conditions.
claim_evidence_requirements.claim_scope: Referenced size, construction, temperature, medium, test method, and other stated operating conditions.
minimum_required_scope: working pressure distinguished from burst pressure
required_identifiers: test method or rating basis where available
claim_evidence_requirements.notes: Never convert burst pressure to working pressure without explicit methodology linkage.

claim_evidence_requirements.claim_text: Provider evidence supports an operating-temperature lower bound at or below -40 degC for the referenced hose or product family under documented conditions.
claim_evidence_requirements.claim_scope: Referenced product family, medium, duration, pressure or installation conditions, and definition of operating temperature.
minimum_required_scope: operating, temporary exposure, storage, or test-condition classification
non_qualifying_evidence: storage limit presented as operating limit
test condition presented as continuous operation
temperature claim from unrelated material or series
claim_evidence_requirements.notes: Do not merge operating, storage, temporary exposure, and test-condition temperatures.

claim_evidence_requirements.claim_text: Provider evidence supports an operating-temperature upper bound at or above +180 degC for the referenced hose or product family under documented conditions.
claim_evidence_requirements.claim_scope: Referenced product family, medium, duration, pressure or installation conditions, and definition of operating temperature.
minimum_required_scope: continuous operation, short-term exposure, sterilization, storage, or test-condition classification
non_qualifying_evidence: sterilization excursion presented as continuous operation
storage limit presented as operating limit
temperature claim from unrelated material or series
claim_evidence_requirements.notes: A sterilization excursion does not establish continuous operation at the same temperature.

claim_evidence_requirements.claim_text: The referenced product family has qualifying documentation addressing 21 CFR 177.2600 for the documented material, article, food-contact use, extraction conditions, and date scope.
claim_evidence_requirements.claim_scope: Exact documented product, material, application, extraction conditions, and applicable date scope only.
claim_evidence_requirements.notes: Do not describe the result as FDA approval or extend it beyond the source scope.

claim_evidence_requirements.claim_text: The referenced product family has qualifying documentation addressing Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004 for the documented material, article, intended food-contact application, and date scope.
claim_evidence_requirements.claim_scope: Exact documented product, material, intended application, supporting measures, and applicable date scope only.
non_qualifying_evidence: declaration for an unrelated material or product
claim_evidence_requirements.notes: Documentation under the framework regulation does not automatically establish every material-specific EU requirement.
